title: SMPTE RP 180 printing-density spectral responsivities
description: Cineon/RP 180 printing density channel responsivities (red/green/blue), peak-normalized as published. Target metric for the Vision3 negative path.
provenance: Extracted 2026-07-16 from the inline table in engine/cineon_pd_engine.py (its sole runtime copy until then); originally transcribed from SMPTE RP 180 in an earlier session. RP_180.pdf itself has not been migrated into this repo.
notes: Includes the sub-400 nm blue tail (380/390 nm). Blue responsivity carries ~3.5% of its integral below 400 nm — relevant to systematics register #1 (380-400 nm grid truncation, Vision3/RP 180 only).
